fittings.name: Shelving unit
fittings.description: Another bay of shelving, twelve spaces, to stand wherever there is floor for it.

fittings.name: Filament rack
fittings.description: A second rack for twenty four more spools, to stand wherever there is floor for it.

fittings.name: Printer rack, two high
fittings.description: Stacks two printers in the floor space of one.

fittings.name: Printer rack, three high
fittings.description: Three printers one above another, for a place with the ceiling for it.

fittings.name: Colour unit rack
fittings.description: Three bays for multicolour units. A printer on a rack has no room for one on top, so its unit sits here and feeds it from the side.

fittings.name: Workbench
fittings.description: A plain bench for two printers, if you want one back.
